mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 225 (CPIAUCSL > 225), it indicates elevated inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 225 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) and high employment level (PAYEMS > 130000) signals labor market distress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS > 130000, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 550), rising housing starts indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 550 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO > 95) reflects robust supply-side economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 95 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures exceed 380000 million dollars (RSAFS > 380000), it signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 380000 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates delayed monetary response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), economic weakness suppresses corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.
